Village house inMarbella,Costa del Sol

Sleeps 10 · 5 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms · Property #487555

This 5 bedroom village house with private pool is located in Elviria, Marbella and sleeps 10 people. It has air conditioning, a jacuzzi and barbecue facilities. The village house is near a beach.

Village house overview

**Inside**

"Villa Serena Marbella", 9-room villa 1'250 m2 on 2 levels. Rustic and tasteful furnishings: living room with open-hearth fireplace (only for decoration), library, digital TV, air conditioning and forced-air heating. Exit to the terrace. Dining room with air conditioning and forced-air heating. Exit to the patio. 1 room with 1 french bed (150 cm, length 200 cm), hand-basin, shower/WC, air conditioning and forced-air heating. 1 room with 1 french bed (160 cm, length 200 cm), library, double hand-basin, air conditioning and forced-air heating. 1 room, window onto the living room with 1 french bed (150 cm, length 190 cm), bath/shower/WC, air conditioning and forced-air heating. 1 room, window onto the living room with 1 french bed (200 cm, length 180 cm), bath/shower/WC, air conditioning and forced-air heating. Large kitchen (1 hot plate, oven, dishwasher, 3 induction hot plates, toaster, kettle, microwave, freezer, electric coffee machine) with dining table, air conditioning and forced-air heating. Sep. WC. Upper floor: 1 room with 1 french bed (190 cm, length 190 cm), open-hearth fireplace, bath/shower/WC, double hand-basin, air conditioning and forced-air heating. Exit to the terrace. Living room. Exit to the terrace. 2 terraces. Terrace furniture, barbecue, deck chairs (4). Very beautiful distant view of the sea and the mountains. Facilities: washing machine, dryer, iron, children's high chair, baby cot, hair dryer. Internet (WiFi, free). Parking (roofed, 4 cars), garage (3 cars). Please note: non-smoking house. Maximum 1 pet/ dog allowed. Smoke alarm, fire extinguisher. Main house consisting of 4 en-suite bedrooms with living room Guest house, living room and first floor bedroom. VUT/MA/93686 // Reg. Nr.: ESFCTU0000290280000763630000000000000000VUT/MA/936863

**Outside**

La Mairena: Large, cosy, rustic villa "Serena Marbella", 2 storeys, surrounded by trees. 2 houses in the residence. 7 km from the sea, 7 km from the beach. Private: natural garden 5 ha (fenced), pond, indoor pool heated (8 x 4 m, depth 120 - 200 cm, seasonal availability: 01.Jan. - 31.Dec.) with internal staircase. Shower/WC in the pool area. In the house: hot tub, lift. Supermarket 6 km, shopping centre 17 km, restaurant 5 km, café 6 km, bus stop "El Camino Parada 8401" 13 km, railway station "Fuengirola" 26 m, sandy beach "Playa de La Víbora" 7 km. Marina 28 km, golf course (18 hole) 11 km, surf school 14 km, tennis 3 km, minigolf 18 km, riding stable 17 km. Nearby attractions: Historic center Marbella 19 km, Mijas Pueblo 30 km, Malaga centro histórico 59 km, Historic center Estepona 45 km, Ronda 115 km, Gibraltar 95 km. Hiking paths: Acueducto NO romano de Linarejos 4 km, Mirador de Las Águilas 12 km, Caminito del Rey - Acceso Norte 75 km. The owner does not accept any youth groups. Indoor swimming pool in glazed area heated to 22 degrees, counter-current pulsating water system.
